photos.desc: Melon-headed whales (Peponocephala electra) Image ID: anim2623, NOAA's Ark Collection Location: Hawaii, Kauai Photographer: Laura Morse Credit: NOAA/NMFS/PIFSC
The Electra dolphin ( Peponocephala electra ) is a cetacean of tropical and subtropical waters that prefers deep waters and the open sea, which makes it difficult to observe.
